what: On a pinned stage, photo rings (N cards per ring, CSS 3D perspective 950px) rotate −360° one after another, passing from 70vh below the screen to −100vh above — cards travel around the ring, bigger toward the front (.6→1.12x), sagging down (vertical arc 85px), turning their heads by −angle×.15°, and the whole ring sways by sin(2θ)×−3°. Each ring takes 3 beats, and the next ring enters .15 beat before the previous one leaves the screen (scrub .8). When the ring changes, the step text switches in .25s and fires an fx:step event

options.radius: Ring radius (px, based on 1200px width — .55~1x depending on width), default 350
options.arc: Vertical arc where the front card sags (px), default 85
options.size: Card side (vw), default 10 — phone (under 768) is 22vw · radius 150 · arc 28
options.tilt: Max angle the whole ring wobbles (°), default 3
options.start: Vertical position where the ring starts, default 70vh
options.pin: With off, the stage isn’t pinned (when the user already pins it)
options.--fx-ratio: Card height-to-width ratio, default 1 — the original Brand is 1.25 (portrait 4:5, stretching downward from the top)
options.[data-fx-part=ring]: One ring — [data-fx-part inside it=card] is the surrounding card (first child is the photo)
options.[data-fx-part=step]: Text group stacked one per ring — only the current ring’s gets is-active, and fx:step fires on el when it changes { index, prev }

note: Text can sit above or below the ring (in the original the text sits at the card’s lower z). Effects inside step text, like splitting letters or counting numbers, are hooked by the user listening to fx:step
